title: Don’t waste your money!!
text: Don’t waste your money!!. [[VIDEOID:843c1e0fb03128a39b2484eebbe906d7]] This product is made horribly! The handle does not sit right, the roof is made unevenly so it will not sit on the product right and if you do manage to get the roof sitting right the handle falls and the roof moves. The whole unit is wonkey and uneven and made poorly!! In the trash it went, along with my $. Buyer beware!!!

product_metadata.title: Kate Aspen 9 Inch White Vintage Distressed Rustic Candle Holder Decorative Lantern, Wedding Decoration, Farmhouse Decor, Table Centerpiece, Home Shelf Decor
features: VINTAGE INSPIRED - Rustic Farmhouse White metal lantern with vintage distressed details; glass windows and metal wire swing handle. Pair multiple lanterns or with different size and color Kate Aspen Lanterns for a custom look.

BEAUTIFUL AND UNIQUE DECORATION - Perfect whether you are creating a beautiful tablescape centerpiece or looking for rustic décor for a special event. Light up the aisle or runway at your wedding for a breathtaking entrance.

CREATE THE PERFECT AMBIANCE - Light up your back porch/deck or add the perfect touch of low light to your living room or kitchen with this farmhouse decor. The unique color and shape of the lantern add a stylish detail to any room.
CANDLE HOLDER w/ REMOVABLE TOP - Lantern holds one candle and features a candle spike and a removable lid for easy access to candle.
MEASUREMENTS - Lantern measures (Unpackaged) 5.4" w x 5.4" d x 9.3" (11" w/ handle) h (5.4" is the width of the lid not the width of the bottom of the lantern) - Packaged: 5.5" w x 5.5" d x 6.9" h
description: This Vintage White Distressed Lantern - Extra Large from Kate Aspen is rustic decor for your wedding ceremony. The special centerpiece shines as a candle holder to place on tables or illuminate the aisle for a fantastic entrance. Country decor includes special tableware and unique decorations that stand out during a rustic celebration. This distressed lantern is elegant with distressed details and glass windows to let the light shine through. The metal wire swing handle allows you to hang the lantern by an entrance for a sparkling light when your party lasts through the night. This distressed lantern from Kate Aspen is the perfect accessory for any occasion with your loved ones. This wedding decor is elegant and full of personality to take home for memories. Features and Facts: Sold individually. White metal lantern with vintage distressed details; glass windows and metal wire swing handle. Candle not included. Without handle: 5. 4" w x 5. 4" d x 9.3" h With handle: 5. 4" w x 5. 4" d x 11" h Packaged: 6. 5" w x 6. 5" d x 6.9" h
